scenario_results.observable_result: the rendered PAR panel preserved an occupied caller-owned destination, recovered to publish a workbook, then imported and previewed that workbook through the canonical PAR flow

assertions: PAR export rejected an occupied caller-owned file without altering its bytes
correcting the destination published a real workbook which the rendered PAR importer diagnosed and previewed

observations.result: rendered occupied-destination recovery, workbook publication, and import/preview
returned the occupied-file error then wrote the recovered workbook
read the UI-produced workbook into the canonical Blueprint model

scenario_results.observable_result: the rendered Design Game editor saved the edited Blueprint through Studio's home workflow

assertions: editing the rendered Blueprint changed the persisted game name before save

observations.result: edited and saved a real Blueprint through Studio's home API
persisted the edited Blueprint at the selected path

scenario_results.observable_result: the rendered Build/Export workflow checked and published the package's CLI-generated Outcome Library through the configured remote delivery adapter

assertions: Build/Export retained the opened package's CLI-generated Outcome Library as the adapter prerequisite
the rendered remote delivery card checked the generated library's compatibility before exposing Publish
Publish wrote the local adapter's deployment output only after the successful compatibility result

observations.result: used the opened package's generated Outcome Library as the remote delivery prerequisite
checked compatibility and published through the configured pc14-ui-delivery adapter
returned the compatible preflight and then the durable published delivery result

scenario_results.observable_result: the rendered Build/Export workflow recovered from an occupied destination and published its real Stake artifact

assertions: Build/Export rendered the server preflight conflict before enabling a durable publication
correcting the output path enabled the same rendered workflow to publish the Stake artifact

observations.result: recovered from the occupied destination and published the real Stake export

scenario_results.observable_result: the rendered Certification workflow rejected a missing source, recovered with the opened Outcome Library, and published inspectable certification evidence

assertions: Certification rendered the missing-source diagnostic before any evidence publication
correcting the source to the opened native library enabled validation, evidence publication, inspection, and export

observations.result: completed source error, validation recovery, build, inspection, and export workflow
returned both the missing-path error and the recovered native-bundle validation
published the real certification evidence bundle consumed by the rendered inspector

scenario_results.observable_result: the rendered Outcome Source drew and displayed a recorded outcome from the opened generated library

assertions: Outcome Source drew a deterministic real outcome from the opened generated library
the rendered draw result is the concrete outcome artifact returned by the native library

observations.result: drew and rendered a real round artifact from the generated Outcome Library
returned the recorded seeded Outcome Library draw

scenario_results.observable_result: the rendered Play workflow retained its unsupported free-games diagnostic and then completed a real package round

assertions: Play rendered the generated package's unsupported free-games diagnostic without discarding the active session
the same rendered Play session recovered by spinning a completed real round artifact

observations.result: created a session, rendered an unsupported free-games diagnostic, then recovered by spinning a completed round artifact

scenario_results.observable_result: the rendered Provably Fair workflow rejected a missing generated-artifact path, recovered with the real Outcome Library, and completed a generated proof verification

assertions: the UI returned the Studio endpoint's path-aware error for a missing Outcome Library
correcting the source path retained the entered seeds and computed the real commitments
the same rendered workflow generated and verified a proof against the CLI-produced Outcome Library

observations.result: recovered from a missing bundle diagnostic and verified a generated proof against the real Outcome Library
rendered both the path error and the recovered commitment result
rendered the generated real round proof
rendered the verified proof result

scenario_results.observable_result: the rendered Replay workflow loaded the persisted Play round and displayed its replay inspector

assertions: Replay consumed the Play workflow's persisted real round rather than a browser fixture
the rendered inspector displayed the recovered package round

observations.result: selected the persisted Play round and rendered its replay artifact inspector

scenario_results.observable_result: the rendered Simulation workflow completed against the generated package and exported its real report

assertions: Simulation completed against the same package and exposed its real report download output

observations.result: ran two rounds, rendered the completed report, and exposed its JSON download

scenario_results.observable_result: the rendered Build/Export Stake card preserved a caller-owned occupied destination, then published a real Stake export after the destination was corrected

assertions: the rendered Stake card received the server preflight conflict for an occupied caller-owned destination
the rejected destination retained its borrowed file unchanged
correcting the destination enabled the real Stake artifact publication and manifest output

observations.result: rendered the occupied-destination error and the recovered Stake publication
returned the resolved occupied-destination conflict then the prepared Stake plan
published the real Stake Engine export after the corrected preflight
